name: tstack-claude
description: Token-frugal fork of pstack-claude. The same rigorous agent workflows, with subagent fan-out replaced by solo sequential work and messaging the sessions you already opened

plugins.name: tstack
plugins.description: If you want to go fast, go deep first — without burning your weekly budget. tstack is a token-frugal fork of pstack: it never spawns subagents. One session does the work, reading only the lines it needs; when you want more hands, it messages the Claude sessions you already opened (lanes) instead of creating new ones. Same rigorous workflows, a fraction of the tokens. Forked from michael-denyer/pstack-claude. Original pstack by Lauren Tan (tstack).
